title: Group chat
lead: The chat is the heart of the app: a conversation of all users, friends' videos and calls.
items: Open it with the big “Chat” button on the home screen. The number shows new messages.
Type in the field at the bottom and tap ➤. Before your first message the app asks you to accept the community rules.
Long-press someone else's message for a menu: write privately, call, add to contacts, report or block the author.
Long-press your own message to delete it.
If a message has a video, tap “▶ Watch” to open it in the player. If it has a source, you can add it with one tap.
New messages are highlighted. When the app is minimised, you get a notification.
Be polite: you can report a violation and block the author — their messages disappear for you.

title: Direct messages
lead: Direct messages are a conversation for two: only you and the other person see it.
items: The ✉ button on the home screen and in the chat opens your conversations. The number shows unread ones.
New conversation: tap an author in the group chat or pick a person in “Contacts”.
Send your “write to me” link to a friend in any messenger — it opens a conversation with you right away.
Long-press a message to delete it, report it or block the person.
Support replies come here too — from “Smart Player”.

title: Calls
lead: A call is a video room in the browser — no sign-up, no passwords.
items: In a conversation or a message menu tap 📞 “Call”. The other person gets an incoming call.
Tap “📞 Join call” — the room opens; allow camera and microphone.
If you are alone in the room, no need to send the link: the other person gets a notification with a “Join call” button.
A missed call arrives as a notification — you can call back.

title: Contacts
lead: Contacts are your address book of people in the app.
items: ☰ → ⋯ More → “Contacts”. Tabs: “My contacts” and “All users” with search by name.
Add people from the group chat, a conversation or the list of all users.
Long-press a contact to rename or remove it.
From a contact you can write or call right away.

title: Notifications
lead: Notifications tell you about direct messages, calls, the group chat and comments on your videos.
items: Allow notifications at first launch — otherwise Android will not show them.
The app icon shows the number of unread messages.
In “Settings” → “Notifications” turn on or off: direct messages and calls, the group chat.
No notifications? Check they are not turned off for Smart Player in Android settings.

title: Video player and sources
lead: The player gathers videos from your phone, magicbtn.online and connected sites into one feed.
items: The “Video player” button on the home screen. At the top are source tabs: “Phone”, magicbtn.online and yours.
“＋ Add a source” — magicbtn.online or any site with the video_api.php file (see “Your site”).
Long-press a source to edit or remove it. Videos on the server are not deleted.
Sorting: newest, oldest, by name, largest, popular, most discussed.
Unneeded folders of a source can be turned off — they disappear from the feed.
Phone videos can be deleted right from the app.

title: Watching: gestures and buttons
lead: In the player everything works with gestures and the buttons on the right.
items: Swipe left or right for the next or previous video. Swipe down to exit.
Double-tap near the left or right edge to skip 10 seconds; several taps in a row add up.
Double-tap the centre of a photo to zoom; pinch with two fingers to zoom too.
A single tap pauses and shows the controls.
On the right: ♥ like, 💬 comments, ↗ share, 🗑 delete your own, 🚩 report.
The player remembers where you stopped and continues from there next time.
⋮ at the top — order (in a row, shuffle, popular), photo interval, video link and the editor.

title: Slideshow and “My views”
lead: Viewing recording turns your slideshow into a ready video.
items: In the player tap ⏺ to start recording. Swipe, zoom, skip — everything is recorded.
👎 while recording — this file will not go into the video. Tap again to bring it back.
⏺ again stops the recording.
☰ → ⋯ More → “My views” → “Make video”. It is made on the phone and saved to the gallery.
You can minimise the app while it is being made — the notification shows “Making a video…”.
Recording also works in the Offline slideshow when one folder is shown.

title: Editor: trimming video
lead: The editor cuts unwanted parts of a video — right while watching or recording.
items: ⋮ → “Editor: trim video”. While recording a slideshow the editor turns on by itself.
The frame around the picture: green — the frame stays, red — it is cut.
“✂ Cut” — from this frame onwards everything is cut, the frame turns red.
“↩ Undo cut” — from this frame onwards everything stays, the frame is green.
−1 s and +1 s step precisely. Go back and the frame shows the status that frame had — you can re-mark from there.
“💾 Save” makes the trimmed video and saves it to the gallery. In “My views” the cut parts do not go into the video either.

title: Sharing a video
lead: You can send your video to the group chat or privately — without compression.
items: In the player tap ↗, or choose “Share” → “Smart Player” in your phone gallery.
Choose the group chat or a person from contacts. Before posting to the group chat the app asks you to confirm.
Videos up to 500 MB upload in chunks and resume on a bad connection. You can minimise the app.
The recipient sees a “▶ Watch” button. The file deletes itself after 30 days.

title: Offline
lead: The player saves what you watched so you can watch without internet.
items: ☰ → ⋯ More → “Offline · slideshow” — everything saved: photos and videos.
What to save is set in “Settings”: everything watched, only liked, or nothing.
No connection — the player shows saved files by itself.
Slideshow: one folder or several at once on a split screen. Tap to pause, swipe down to exit.
A file can be deleted right during the slideshow.

title: My source
lead: My source is your folder on magicbtn.online for showing your videos and photos to others.
items: ☰ → ⋯ More → “My source” → “Create my source”.
Upload videos and photos — the limits are shown on the screen.
“💬 Share in chat” — others add your source with one tap.
“Delete source for everyone” removes the folder with all files from the server.

title: Your site → source
lead: Any hosting with videos can become a source for the player.
items: ☰ → ⋯ More → “Your site → source” — the app gives you video_api.php (or a Python version) and instructions.
Put the file on your hosting next to the video folders and set your key in it.
In the player “＋ Add a source” → site address and key. Every folder becomes a section.

title: Game
lead: The game is a kind tower defence for kids and adults, with no ads and no internet needed.
items: The “Game” button on the home screen opens your level right away.
Place the friends on the path of the tailed guests and complete the levels.
Exit with 🏠 in the game or the phone's Back button.

title: Statistics
lead: The home screen buttons can show statistics — simple weekly charts.
items: Under “Chat”, “Video player” or “Game” tap “📊 Collect statistics”.
“🔄 Refresh” shows a chart: how much you wrote, watched or how many minutes you played.
Statistics are kept only on your phone.

title: Menu, settings and themes
lead: Everything rare is in the ☰ menu and under “⋯ More”.
items: ☰ at the top of the home screen: profile and frequent items on top, the rest under “⋯ More”.
Profile (tap your name in the menu): name, avatar, app language and theme.
“Settings”: app password (and fingerprint), offline downloads, storage, notifications.
The password is asked at launch and after 30 seconds in the background.
“Theme” — five looks, switches instantly.
Updates: the app offers a new version by itself.

title: Ideas and support
lead: Missing something or something broke — write to me, I read every request.
items: ☰ → ⋯ More → “Suggest an idea”. The 🎲 button suggests an idea if you don't know where to start.
The reply comes to your direct messages from “Smart Player”.
“Help” on the home screen always opens this section.
